name: FIRE (engine)
description: Overtemperature detected in an engine compartment. Warning Unit shows FIRE and audio tone, Master List shows ENG1 FIRE or ENG2 FIRE, voice message "FIRE, ENGINE ONE/TWO FIRE".

procedure.heading: In flight:
procedure.text:
1. OEI flight condition — Establish
2. FIRE sw (affected engine) — Raise guard, press
3. BOT 1/BOT 2 pb — Press; bottle 1 activated
4. Clock stop watch — Start, after BOT1 and EXT light extinguish
5. VMS page — Select, identify affected engine
6. Single engine emergency shutdown — Perform
7. Passengers — Alert
Extinguisher bottle begins discharging when N1 ≤ 45%. After discharge, BOT 1 label and EXT light go off; BOT 2 label comes on.

procedure.heading: If FIRE warning still on after 1 minute:

procedure.text: If the FIRE warning remains on after both bottles have discharged: LAND IMMEDIATELY.
